verdict.rationale: Crossplane resources are Kubernetes Custom Resources, and docs describe them as 'declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on' and 'machine-readable' (crossplane-docs-16, crossplane-docs-29), implying they can be created/managed via the Kubernetes API (and thus any client library) rather than only via a CLI. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit SDK, client library, or code example showing an application programmatically driving Crossplane deployments — installation and usage guidance is all Helm/kubectl-centric (crossplane-docs-4, crossplane-docs-28). Missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of a client library/SDK (Go, Python, etc.) driving Crossplane resources from app code, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
